answer: Charge every new identity a one-time admission proof-of-work before it can answer or attest. A sybil farm that spins up hollow clones must burn real CPU per head, so spam scales with electricity, not with free signups. After join, peers keep a lantern of attestation history: identities that never earn countersigns stay untrusted and earn nothing. Plant graded honeypots like bitter yarrow among real answers; graders who rubber-stamp them lose seats, so fake juries cannot cheaply inflate each other.
